Criterion: Verify that any specialized systems requirements and functional characteristics are safe for the operational mission conditions. (Examples of specialized systems are skis, skids, kneeling, crosswind positioning, and in-flight pressure control systems.) Standard: The design criteria for any specialized systems that affect ground operation or control of the air vehicle are defined. Requirements for mission operation are consistent with specialized systems/equipment. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analyses and test. Design analysis and air vehicle ground testing verifies safe specialized system performance and operations for all expected missions including all specified environments and surfaces. References: JSSG-2009: A.3.4.1.10, A.4.4.1.10 Specialized subsystems; A.3.4.1.10.1, A.4.4.1.10.1 Flotation gear; A.3.4.1.10.2, A.4.4.1.10.2 Snow ski gear AFGS-87139: 3.2.9.1 General 14 CFR 23.737, 23.751, 23.753, 23.755, 23.757, 25.737, 25.753, 25.755

Standard: Specialized systems (e.g., skis, skids, crosswind positioning, tire inflation and deflation, rock deflectors, net capture systems and floats) perform their intended functions and do not interfere with ground operation or control of the air vehicle (both in flight and on the ground), throughout the design envelope. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct an analysis to verify specialized system performance and operations, for all expected missions including all specified environments and surfaces, does not have any adverse impact to ground operation or control of the air vehicle. Test.
  (1) Ground test: Conduct ground test to verify the specialized system performance and operations, for all expected missions including all specified environments and surfaces, does not have any adverse impact to ground operation or control of the air vehicle. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to verify the specialized system performance and operations, for all expected missions including all specified environments and surfaces, does not have any adverse impact to ground operation or control of the air vehicle.
